product.name: Trademark Protection
product.description: Service granting exclusive rights over phrases, images, and logos associated with a business to protect brand identity.

product.name: Patent Protection
product.description: Service to protect inventions by granting exclusive rights over their use and commercial exploitation for a limited period.

product.name: Online Brand Protection
product.description: Continuous monitoring of online platforms to detect trademark infringements, counterfeiting, and other harmful activities affecting brand reputation.

product.name: Anti-Counterfeiting Services
product.description: Services to identify, investigate, and act against counterfeit products in the market to protect intellectual property rights.

product.name: Domain Acquisition
product.description: Service to negotiate and acquire already registered domain names relevant to a client's trademark or business interests.

product.name: Domain Dispute Resolution
product.description: Service to resolve disputes over domain names registered or used in bad faith, including cybersquatting and identity theft.
